Test Case Name: User can sign in with valid credentials and view the dashboard
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to the login page using locator `page.goto('https://www.scriptedqa.com/home')` or `page.locator('input[placeholder='Username']')` after page load.
2. Fill username using locator `input[placeholder='Username']` with text `admin`.
3. Fill password using locator `input[placeholder='Password']` with text `Pass@9211`.
4. Click the Sign In button using locator `button:has-text('Sign In')`.
5. Verify the dashboard header using locator `text='Welcome back, Automation Engineer!'`.
Values: Username = admin; Password = Pass@9211; Expected welcome text = 'Welcome back, Automation Engineer!'
Expected Result: The user logs in successfully and lands on the authenticated dashboard with the welcome message visible.

Test Case Name: User can sign out and return to the login screen
Test Steps:
1. Click the Sign Out button using locator `button:has-text('Sign Out')`.
2. Wait for redirect back to the login form.
3. Verify the Username field using locator `input[placeholder='Username']` is visible and empty.
4. Verify the Password field using locator `input[placeholder='Password']` is visible and empty.
Values: Action = Sign Out; After logout, Username and Password fields are empty
Expected Result: The session is ended and the user is redirected to the login screen.
